description: The figure-eight (az-figure-eight/orbit.json) over one period on its own sync interval T/32 at η = 0.001, Aarseth–Zare + RK4 under the step control in force (integrator contract Part 2b, Part 6's per-step rule) with the landing clamp and secant: its closure within REQ-INT-114's threshold, and its convergence over the η ladder against a run at η = 1e-4 better than first order (REQ-INT-049; R-927).
